decisions.statement: A body names the generated declarations of that body by that body's folder and name.
A name with no leading dot lands against the folder of the body naming that name.
Such a name reading the same from where the body lands is left as it is spelled.
The paths that moved arrive as a plain object rather than as a map.
The map read off that object is kept against the object it was read off.
One caller repointing many bodies hands the same object down and reads it once.
A caller hands in the paths that moved or the folder that moved.
A caller handing in the folder states the folder it was and the folder it is.
A caller handing in both is read as having handed in the folder.
Where a path lands is one question asked the same way whichever was handed in.
A body naming the folder that moved, or a path under it, follows that folder.
A reading landing under that folder is a path this repository has, or is left alone.
A reading closing on a separator is asked of the repository without it.
A path the paths that moved name is one this repository has already.
A name with no separator is a name rather than a path naming that folder.
A run that is a path this repository has names that path rather than an ending of it.
Whether a path is one this repository has is asked of the world one path at a time.
A world answering that nowhere reads every ending rather than stopping at one.
A specifier naming a package other than the root is left as it is whatever moved.
A name opening with the root package spells a path from the root and follows what moved.
A way in is repointed at the file.
A specifier is respelled only where the path that specifier spells moved.
No manifest is read here.
The body is read from the path that body sits at once the caller has carried it.
A body that is not text names no path.
A body that is not code is read as the runs of path characters that body holds.
A reading of such a run that is a whole path that moved takes the path that path landed at.
The rest of the run around that reading is left as the body spells it.
A name or a run closing on a separator closes on it once it is respelled.
A run relative to the body landing on a path that moved is respelled from where the body sits.
A relative run is read that one way rather than by any shorter reading of it.
A run matching a path that moved only by an ending several such paths share is left alone.
Which of those paths such a run names is unanswerable, and answering it would name one silently.
A relative run in a body that moved is respelled where that run names a path outside what moved.
A body that moved deeper climbs the right number of levels in every run it holds.
A path a body builds off the folder that body sits in follows what moved, as a name does.
Such a path built out of anything but written letters refuses the change and is named.
Two rewrites of the same letters spelling one body are taken as one rewrite.
Two rewrites of the same letters spelling two bodies refuse the change.
A name opening with the root package is never respelled against a folder.
A string in code that is no path of its own is read as the runs that string holds.
A specifier is read as a whole path or as nothing rather than as runs.
A change wanting these edits reads them here rather than from another change.

definition: a body rewritten so the paths it names follow the files that moved
